summary: ansible_search_path holds the searched paths in order (without subdirectories), and -vvvvv reports each directory searched except for task files.
questions: How do I debug which paths Ansible searched for a file?

answer_card.title: Troubleshooting search paths
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ansible_search_path` contains the searched paths in order (subdirectories not listed).
- Run with **`-vvvvv`** to see each directory as it's searched (except for tasks files).
